description:
Trakt to Discord Rich Presence

Discrakt bridges your Trakt.tv watching status to Discord Rich Presence. It runs silently in your system tray and automatically updates your Discord status when watching movies or TV shows tracked by Trakt.tv.
macOS installers are now available separately for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs:
- Apple Silicon: Discrakt_4.1.5_arm64.dmg
- Intel: Discrakt_4.1.5_x86_64.dmg
Each installer contains only its native architecture. The app bundles are Developer ID signed, and the DMGs are notarized. Homebrew continues to select the correct architecture automatically.
